comment: Spoon is work in progress. Its widget loads A Saw B's panel (src/Spoon.cpp:82), so the artwork and lettering are wrong; only on a theme change does step() try to load res/panels/Spoon.svg, which is not in the installed plugin. FEEDBACK_PARAM is placed on the panel at line 86 but is never passed to configParam and never read in process, so it is dead and has no tooltip. TRIG_IN is declared and read at line 65 but no jack is added for it, so no click can reach it and it gets no line here. The module browser's description, 'Variable hardness clipper', is copied from Plastic Wrap. The maker's manual has no section for this module. The Friction knob runs 0 to 10 and the Tension knob 0.8 to 12, both used as powers of two.
